card.name: Not currently/already taking before a drug
card.fires_on: The word currently or already right after "not" in dosing text about patients not on a drug. It also fires on a word that comes just before a present-state verb, such as now or towers.

modes.label: Noun or adverb before a present-state phrase
modes.description: A noun or time adverb in narrative text, followed by a verb about where something is or stands.
modes.example: where the Saint's holy<< relics>> are located.

card.writes: It promotes words meaning currently or existing, and suppresses words about the recent past such as yesterday.
card.plain: It marks the spot where text says what someone is already taking or what exists now.
